verdict.rationale: The only first-party evidence of a multi-item operation is that `npm install` installs a project's dependencies in one command, which is a bulk install across many packages. Nothing else in the pack shows general bulk operations across items. `npm ls` only lists installed packages and does not act on them. missing for 10: documented bulk update/uninstall/deprecate/publish across many packages, multi-package or workspace-wide command execution, batch registry API operations, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: The very first thing you will most likely want to run in any node program is `npm install` to install its dependencies.
